title: ReducedX-Anti Cheat
description: Professional Anti-Cheat plugin for Minecraft servers with advanced detection, punishment GUI, and full staff management system
body:
# ReducedX — Professional Anti-Cheat

ReducedX is a powerful and lightweight anti-cheat plugin designed for Paper and Spigot servers running Minecraft 1.21+. Built with performance and accuracy in mind, it detects a wide range of cheats while keeping false positives to a minimum

## Combat Detection
KillAura detection using angle and rotation analysis. Reach check for attacks beyond 3.2 blocks. AutoClicker detection with CPS variance analysis. AntiKnockback and Hitbox exploit detection

## Movement Detection
Speed, Fly, NoFall, Jesus, Step and Scaffold detection. All checks include lag compensation and TPS-based safe mode to avoid false positives on laggy servers

## World Detection
XRay detection using mining path analysis and ore rate tracking. FastPlace detection for suspicious block placement speed

## Server Protection
PacketFlood protection against packet spam attacks. JoinFlood and ReconnectSpam protection against bot attacks

## Staff Tools
Professional /punish GUI with multi-step flow. Per-permission button access — helpers can only use what they are allowed to. Warn, Kick, TempMute, TempBan, PermBan and IP Ban support. Staff alerts with Low, Medium and High alert levels. Spectate players silently directly from the GUI

## Configuration
Fully customizable via config.yml and lang.yml. Every message, prefix, sensitivity and threshold is editable. Per-world check control and bypass permission support. Violation decay system and combination detection included

## Commands
/rx — Plugin info and help
/punish — Open punishment GUI
/rx info — View player violations
/rx logs — View flag history
/rx alerts — Toggle personal alerts
/rx spectate — Silently spectate a player
/rx reload — Reload config and lang

Author: ReducedG
